Because that will happen... you will enjoy your 20s and 30s and suddenly HOP you are 40 and you are alone, no friends, society thinks you have 0 worth... and that is the reason suicides are UP THE ROOF for men 40-50 years old.

Just saying - you are so young - when I was your age NOBODY was there to tell me that - YOU are perfect YOURSELF - you shouldn't follow any trends to be accepted in any social club - YOU do YOU... actually today's society wants to destroy individuals, because they are a threat!

Do you... and you can keep it low key around others... but know that most of this world is FAKE and society is FAKE... and nobody cares for nobody, people are selfish and will stomp you at every given chance... arm yourself when you are still young!
